_about: Language-agnostic spec for a deterministic cost-tier router. THIS FILE is the reusable asset: any app (Go/Rust/TS/Python/bash) loads it and implements the same ~15-line matcher — lowercase the task, walk rules in order, first regex (ERE, case-insensitive) that matches wins, else `default`. See README.md. route.sh is the reference implementation; bench.sh scores any implementation against evalset.tsv.

haiku.use: mechanical / low-reasoning: typos, renames, formatting, comments, version bumps, one-liners

sonnet.use: default: features, fixes, tests, refactors, docs

opus.use: high-stakes reasoning: architecture, security/auth/crypto, concurrency, migrations, multi-tenancy, protocol/threat design

_cost_note: cost is a RELATIVE weight (~output $/Mtok ratio: haiku 1 : sonnet 4 : opus 20 ≈ real Anthropic ratios). Edit to your actual prices; bench.sh reports cost-at-iso-quality from these.
